about: Canonical Petunia3D UI component map: every visual surface, where it renders (shell region), and what it connects to (state, commands, other components). Hand-authored; validated by `cargo xtask ui-check` (unique ids, files, entry symbols, regions, acyclic children). Line numbers are approximate.

nodes.position: root shell orchestration, called from app canvas
Panel::top main_header, 3 columns (menus | centered pills | actions), no brand
Panel::bottom status_bar, full width, sole bottom panel
top section in toolbar, Model workspace
middle section in toolbar, Model workspace
bottom section in toolbar, Model + Edit mode only
sole section in toolbar, Paint workspace
sole section in toolbar, UV workspace
sole section in toolbar, Animate workspace
right dock top section, draggable split
right dock bottom section, draggable split
right dock top, fills parent height
outliner tree section 4, only if refs exist
painted over viewport rect, owns dispatch order
viewport rect at each vert projection (Edit+Vertex)
viewport rect infinite lines through pivot
central bottom strip TIMELINE_HEIGHT, Animate only
central split (wide) or toggle (narrow), UV only
adaptive Scene height (auto content estimate vs manual fraction)
text + painted vector chevron via Popup::menu (never font glyph)
trailing chevron, hidden clusters stay operable
gear popup: visibility, up/down order, 1-2 columns, reset
sticky active-object header (collapse + rename + search + pin + eye + lock)
context text tabs (Object/Modify/Material/...) without icon rail
temporary modal operation block + active tool params
funnel popup (section toggles + object state + auto-size)
